newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: HERMIS BANK APRIL PROFIT 3.2 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: HERMIS BANK APRIL PROFIT 3.2 MLN LITAS.

text.p: One of Lithuania's biggest banks Hermis Bank said on Wednesday that its preliminary net profit in April was 3.2 million litas compared to 1.15 million litas in April 1996.
"According to preliminary data our net profit last month was 3.2 million compared to 1.15 million litas in April 1996," deputy chairman of the bank, Vytautas Jurna, told Reuters.
"The bank's net profit during the four months of the year was 12.5 million litas compared to 5.57 million litas in the same period last year," Jurna added.
Jurna said that the final figures on bank's net profit,assets, loan portfolio will be known on May 10.
